name: 92124 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92124 (San Diego) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92124 (San Diego) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92124 (San Diego) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).
